description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationUtility class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods related to retrieving default locations based on global properties and user settings.

classes.name: LocationUtilityTest
classes.description: Test class for LocationUtility, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to provide context for OpenMRS core testing environment.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation_shouldReturnTheUpdatedDefaultLocationWhenTheValueOfTheGlobalPropertyIsChanged
methods.description: Tests that LocationUtility.getDefaultLocation() returns the updated location after changing the global property value.

methods.name: getUserDefaultLocation_shouldReturnTheUserSpecifiedLocationIfAnyIsSet
methods.description: Tests that LocationUtility.getUserDefaultLocation() correctly returns the location specified by the user, with setup involving user properties and context logout/login.
